name: pplx-decider-v1.2 (27B decision model; also flash)

lineage.how_derived: decision-model fine-tune; v1.2 reads a state plus several questions in one sequence with one readout per question; trained on a reworked data mix including decontaminated Decision Index training splits; checkpoints combined by model souping (card)
lineage.family: pplx-decider (v1-27b, v1.1-27b, v1.2, flash v1.2, GGUF flash)

purpose: Decision model: answers multiple-choice style questions about a state (text or image up to 1.6 MP) with one forward pass instead of generating text, so that routing, tool and retrieval decisions are cheap (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card tag)
license.notes: Card tag; a LICENSE file exists in the repo (not read).

architecture.kind: Qwen3.5-architecture hybrid backbone (Qwen3_5Model, full-attention interval 4, hidden 5120) used as a classifier with per-question readout markers

variants.notes: repo total per HF API; 6.1k downloads, 81 likes

pc-12gb.variant: BF16 (the flash GGUF is the practical local option)
pc-12gb.notes: 52.2 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-16gb.variant: BF16 (the flash GGUF is the practical local option)
pc-16gb.notes: 52.2 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-24gb.variant: BF16 (the flash GGUF is the practical local option)
pc-24gb.notes: 52.2 GB file against 21.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-32gb.variant: BF16 (the flash GGUF is the practical local option)
pc-32gb.notes: 52.2 GB file against 29.6 GB VRAM plus 114 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

mac-16-24gb.variant: BF16 (the flash GGUF is the practical local option)
mac-16-24gb.notes: 52.2 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.variant: BF16 (the flash GGUF is the practical local option)
mac-32gb.notes: 52.2 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.variant: BF16 (the flash GGUF is the practical local option)
mac-64gb+.notes: 52.2 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

benchmarks.name: Decision Index 0.3 overall
benchmarks.harness: v1.1-27b: 62.30; one question per request 67.75; the card says the training mix now includes official training splits of several Decision Index benchmarks (decontaminated)

strengths: one pass for several questions about the same state
weaknesses: 52 GB BF16; the flash variants are the small option
benchmark partly in-domain after training on public splits (card says so)
soft.maturity: Perplexity; v1 in October, v1.2 within three weeks; llama.cpp and vLLM support landed quickly.

tona_fit.reason: Part of a new family of decision models (Liquid d1, Cloudflare Clef, Granite Switch Decision, CLM) that llama.cpp and vLLM now support natively. Potentially useful as a router or tool-choice head in agent loops; too specialised to offer as a worker model today.
blockers: needs a decision-model API in the server

open_questions: Independent results beyond the vendor's Decision Index
